issues.quote: At a quarter past ten by my watch someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door. I didn't see who. The door was shut. Then at twenty-one minutes past ten by my watch someone came quickly down.
issues.fact: F4 says the upward passage at 10:15 happened before the thump, and the downward passage at 10:21 is a separate event. The fact sheet gives no order between the 10:21 descent and the 10:18 thump beyond the clock readings.
issues.misreading: The transcript narrates the 10:21 descent before the 10:18 thump, with no 'before the thump' marker on the stair events. A solver reading the narrative order could take the thump to have come after the person went back down, when the clock readings put the 10:21 descent after the thump.
